annotation.authors_or_issuer: CORDIS (European Commission); RoboLaw project consortium coordinated by Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna
key_provisions_or_claims: Examines whether existing EU/national legal frameworks are adequate for emerging robotics or whether new regulation is needed.
Proposes special liability rules for healthcare robotics: surgical robots, prostheses, care robots.
Aligns ethical analysis of robotics with Responsible Research and Innovation and EU fundamental rights.
Balances consumer protection and innovation/competitiveness in regulating robotics.
Studies human enhancement technologies and their implications for identity and social values.
annotation.summary_en: CORDIS final report summary of the FP7 RoboLaw project (2012–2014), which examined whether existing law suffices for emerging robotics in Europe, using a Responsible Research and Innovation lens. It proposes special liability rules for healthcare robots (surgical, prostheses, care) and addresses human enhancement and fundamental rights.
annotation.title_clean: Regulating Emerging Robotic Technologies in Europe: Robotics facing Law and Ethics (RoboLaw) - Final Report Summary
